items.basis: The claimed 4x bridging threshold increase from doubling the throat diameter is mathematically inconsistent with the stated bridging mechanism. Bridging typically scales with the square root of the throat-to-particle ratio, not linearly, making the claimed 4x improvement impossible. GROUNDED_IN: COMPUTATION <bridging scales with throat-to-particle ratio; if bridging scales with square root of ratio, doubling throat diameter would only increase threshold by sqrt(2) ≈ 1.4x, not 4x>
